title: Hosts
description: Machines that run Manar components, the install keys that enrol them, and the rules that approve them.
accessDeniedBody: Hosts are visible to Tenant Owners, Security Admins and Auditors.
readOnlyNote: Read-only: your role can view hosts but not change them.
selfReported: Key type and hostname are reported by the machine itself. Manar does not verify them with hardware attestation yet, so treat the install key as the control and these as filters.

hosts.softwareKeyHint: Reported as a software key, not hardware-backed. Reported by the machine, not verified.

rekey.otherGroup: Also asks to move to another group.

confirm.approveBody: The host can then receive and renew its certificate.
confirm.approveRekeyBody: Binds the requested key and revokes the certificates of the current key. Only the key shown below is approved.
confirm.rejectBody: The host gets no certificate. You can approve it later.
confirm.rejectRekeyBody: Drops the request. The host keeps its current key.
confirm.revokeBody: Revokes its certificates now. It can't register again with the same machine ID.
confirm.removeBody: Deletes this device and its certificates, so it can be installed again from scratch. Its audit history stays.

installKeys.revokeBody: No machine can register with this key afterwards. Hosts already registered keep their approval.

form.title: Create install key
form.description: An install key registers machines into one host group and grants nothing else.
form.label: Label
form.rangesHint: One per line, for example 10.0.0.0/8. Leave empty for any address.

shown.title: Copy your install key now
shown.warning: You won't see this key again. Store it somewhere safe; if you lose it, revoke it and create another.

rules.empty: No approval rules. Every new host waits for a person.
rules.description: A new machine is approved automatically when every condition set on a rule matches. Otherwise it waits for a person.

form.title: Approval rule
form.patternHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore, plus * and ? (at most three *). Leave empty for any hostname.
form.rangesHint: One per line. Leave empty for any address.
